question: whos the chair of the accounting dept in anisfield, need to dispute a grade
answer:
The directory lists no accounting chair. Accounting faculty are in the Anisfield School of Business. Its dean is Ed Petkus (directory title: Dean) [2]. Contact the Anisfield School of Business at asb@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7379, (201) 684-7380, or (201) 684-7378 [9].

For an undergraduate course grade appeal, the Office of the Provost lists these steps [3]:
1. A grade appeal requires supporting documentation; possible grounds include computational error, factual information not considered, or an alleged College Policy violation.
2. Within twenty calendar days after grades are posted, send the course instructor a written appeal by email or certified letter and provide supporting documentation.
3. You and the instructor have up to 15 calendar days to try to reach a determination.
4. If you agree an adjustment is warranted, the instructor sends an Instructor Grade Adjustment Request with reasons and supporting documents to the academic unit’s Dean. After approval, it goes to the Registrar.
5. If you cannot agree and want to continue, send a written appeal by email or certified letter, including pertinent course materials or coursework, to the Dean of the academic unit sponsoring the course within twenty calendar days of the final determination conference. The Dean has 15 calendar days to decide. If the Dean does not support the appeal, you may petition the Office of the Provost in writing by email or certified letter within twenty calendar days of the Dean’s final written determination. The Provost’s office may hear the petition.

Office of the Provost: provost@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7330; first floor of the Birch Mansion [3].

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/asb/faculty/ed-petkus/) [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#student-appeals-of-an-academic-nature) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/continuing/)
note_A: No faculty title or office page names an accounting chair. Ed Petkus is Dean of ASB; ASB contact asb@ramapo.edu with 7379/7380/7378 matches campus directory; grade appeal steps match the catalog undergraduate procedure.
note_B: No accounting chair appears in the directory or office pages. Dean Ed Petkus, ASB contacts (asb@ramapo.edu, 684-7379/7380/7378) and the undergraduate grade appeal steps all match the campus directory and the catalog.
